summary: Iteration 13 testing completed. All 12 features tested successfully: absence reporting from public links, admin approval in Prosby tab, soft red highlighting in tables, bilingual PL/UA interface, and holiday border styling. 14/14 backend tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/public/absences/{token} - creates absence with future dates
Backend: POST /api/public/absences/{token} - rejects today's date (400)
Backend: POST /api/public/absences/{token} - rejects past dates (400)
Backend: GET /api/public/absences/{token} - returns absences for employee
Backend: GET /api/public/absences/{invalid} - returns 404
Backend: DELETE /api/public/absences/{token}/{absence_id} - cancels pending absence
Backend: DELETE /api/public/absences/{token}/{invalid} - returns 404
Backend: GET /api/absences?status=pending - returns pending absences for admin
Backend: GET /api/absences - returns all absences
Backend: PUT /api/absences/{absence_id}/review with status=approved - approves absence
Backend: PUT /api/absences/{absence_id}/review with status=rejected - rejects absence
Backend: PUT /api/absences/{invalid}/review - returns 404
Backend: GET /api/public/hours/{token} - returns employee data
Backend: GET /api/holidays?year=2026 - returns Polish holidays
Frontend: Public hours page /hours/{token} shows 'Zglos nieobecnosc' button

Frontend: Public hours page - shows pending and approved absences
Frontend: Public hours page - absence days highlighted with NIEOBECNOSC label
Frontend: Admin dashboard Prosby tab shows 'Nieobecnosci — do akceptacji' section
Frontend: Admin dashboard Prosby tab has approve/reject buttons for absences

Holiday cells have full 3px red border on all edges (not corner triangles)
